--- Page 1 (Beckerman_08a) --- Dear Jack, Received your letter of Jan 6 about more than a week ago. But as you probably found out or read in the news. The 1st Corps took another boot and we are at a new place. We are now set up right in the middle of a town and it is pretty nice here, no kidding. The country is really nice and beautiful here. There are plenty of guerrillas here and old Philippine recruits. I also saw about [illegible] who lived in the --- Page 2 (Beckerman_08b) --- II mountains since the Japs took over here. I talked with all of them and they sure have some stories to tell. Sorry I can't take you up on the offer you asked me about, since I am not at loose Kang longer. By the way I was in the 118th Inf. for a days last month with a slight case of yellow jaundice. But I am well now and everything is alright and though I didn't mention anything of it to the folks. I did get a letter from Chubby the day I left and I didn't answer it yet. I got a V-mail from Harry and am --- Page 3 (Beckerman_08c) --- [illegible] it to you as he said I should. We are now sleeping on a cement floor which is part of a porch of an old schoolhouse which the Japs burned before the took off from here. you will have to excuse the bad writing since I am not in a very good position for writing. Well that's about all for now so I will close with congratulations on your promotion & good luck ale
